title: UK inflation falls sharply to 3.2% amid slowdown in food price rises
summary: Drop in November annual rate adds to case for Bank of England cut to interest rates on Thursday Business live – latest updates UK inflation fell by more than expected in November amid a slowdown in food prices, official figures show, strengthening the case for the Bank of England to cut interest rates on Thursday. In a crunch week for the economy, the Office for National Statistics said the rate as measured by the consumer prices index eased to 3.2% last month from a reading of 3.6% in October. City economists had forecast a modest drop to 3.5%. Continue reading...
